Home / Learn / Maths Path / PP2

Maths Path · Ages 4 to 5

Pre-primary 2 maths

Numbers to 20, shapes and patterns. Go in order. Pass each check to open the next chapter.

0 of 7 passed

PP2 chapters in order

  1. 1

    Numbers up to 20

    Build a ten, count the loose ones and find neighbours.

    • I can show numbers up to 20.
    • I can find before, after and between.
    • I can compare numbers and skip-count.
    Not started
  2. 2

    Add and take away

    Join groups, remove objects and find a hidden part.

    • I can add two small groups.
    • I can find what is left.
    • I can find a missing part.
    Not started
  3. 3

    Flat shapes and solid things

    Connect shapes to real objects and simple position clues.

    • I can count sides and corners.
    • I can recognise a solid by how it moves.
    • I can join shapes to make a picture.
    Not started
  4. 4

    Long, heavy and full

    Compare objects with common units and informal balances.

    • I can compare lengths and sizes.
    • I can measure with equal blocks.
    • I can compare weight and capacity.
    Not started
  5. 5

    Find the pattern

    Repeat a group, fill a gap and predict a growing picture.

    • I can continue a repeating group.
    • I can fill a gap in a pattern.
    • I can spot a broken rule.
    Not started
  6. 6

    Follow the picture clues

    Use positions, arrows and two visible clues.

    • I can find a place in a row.
    • I can choose a picture using two clues.
    • I can follow arrows on a map.
    Not started
  7. 7

    Days, months and clocks

    Talk about daily routines, weekday order and whole hours together.

    • I can say the day before or after.
    • I can put familiar months in order.
    • I can recognise a whole hour on a clock.
    Not started
